## Tech Stack
- Markdown SKILL.md files — Claude Code skill format
- YAML frontmatter — clarify brief classification metadata (parsed via `yaml.safe_load`)
- Python 3 + `power_search` library — all search/extract/generate calls
- Bash — minor helpers where needed
- JSON — ResearchState persistence at `.cortex/research-state/{slug}.json`

## Conventions
- Classification lives in YAML frontmatter at the top of clarify briefs, not inline tags
- Unknown question types are hard errors, not silent defaults
- Default unclassified questions to `factual` (cheapest route)
- Trust `power_search` natural fallback chains — don't reinvent error handling
- Log actually-used provider in dossier source list (visibility into fallback)
- Atomic writes for ResearchState (tmp + rename)
- Archive (don't delete) completed state for debugging

## Architecture Rules
- 5-type taxonomy: factual / landscape / mechanism / comparison / codebase
- Classification at clarify time, routing at research time (two-phase)
- Depth controls budget per question, NOT provider choice
- `--agentic` requires `--depth standard` or `--depth deep` (hard block on quick)
- Agentic loop uses Generator + Digester + Evaluator personas (separate LLM calls)
- Generator cannot self-terminate — only evaluator sets `done: true`
- Hard limits (iterations, cost USD, wall time) override quality-based termination
- Source authority ranking: arxiv/gov/official docs > dev.to/medium > linkedin/reddit
